**COMPANY OVERVIEW**
 
Amrize is building North America. From bridges and railways to data centers, schools, offices and homes, our solutions are inside the buildings and infrastructure that connect people and advance how we live. And we invite you to come and build with us.

As the partner of choice for professional builders, we offer advanced branded solutions from foundation to rooftop. Wherever our customers are, whatever their job, we’re ready to deliver. Our 19,000 colleagues work across 1,000 sites supported by an unparalleled distribution network. Infrastructure, commercial and residential, new build, repair and refurbishment: We’re in every construction market.

Amrize listed on the New York Stock Exchange and the SIX Swiss Exchange on June 23, 2025, following our spinoff as an independent company. Join us and build *your* ambition.

Learn more atwww.amrize.com/careers

Description:

Join Amrize as a Plant Manager - Aggregate and help construct what's next. If you're ready to put your skills to work on projects that matter — and build a career with a company that’s building North America — we want to hear from you!

 

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The basic function of the Plant Manager is to provide the necessary leadership to plan, direct, organize, coordinate and control the mining of raw materials and the production of shippable product at the assigned Plant in a manner to meet Aggregate Dispatcher requests on a timely and cost efficient basis. The Plant Manager will be tasked with ensuring that an appropriate quality product is made at the Plant.

The Plant Manager will ensure proper staffing and monitoring of the inventory status at the Plant and in addition will coordinate activities with the following departments: Aggregate Operations Department - Dispatch, Maintenance, and Quality Control of the Region in addition Regional Administration/Financial function.

The Plant Manager will analyze and monitor production efficiency / productivity to ensure the Company is fully utilizing on site vehicles and plant equipment at the assigned location. In addition, the Plant Manager will develop mining and production strategies and tactics to ensure an approach to raise productivity levels, maintaining safety as a top propriety, while controlling the costs of the assigned location.

 

**WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH**

* Consistently identify new operational opportunities and develop strategies for accomplishing the attainment of improved efficiency and productivity.
* Address the needs of the customer while at the same time promoting and protecting the long-term interests of the Company.
* Initiate and implement production and scheduling related programs, strategies and techniques that result in increased productivity, and maintain safe operations of the assigned Plant, while containing the budgeted expenses of the assigned plants.
* Manage the performances of subordinate personnel, work independently, meet deadlines and manage the assigned Plant with fiscal integrity.
* Delegate responsibilities; must be able to objectively evaluate the performance of subordinates; and must be able to hold others accountable in a constructive manner.
* Participate in Company safety inspections.
* Communicate with site crew which includes plant operator, loader operators and laborers
* Supervise team to maintain production and efficiency. Schedule production and execute preventative maintenance routines
* Maintain sufficient inventory levels at site to service customers’ needs
* Coordinate safety issues and investigate incidents with safety department. Ensure environmental compliance, rehabilitation and meeting permit obligations
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas. Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.
 

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

**Education:** Bachelor's degree

**Field of Study Preferred:** Mining Engineering, Management
 
**Required Work Experience**: 5-7 years Aggregate Mining and related Raw Materials Plant Production experience

**Required Technical Skills:** Computer proficiency required. SAP experience would be a plus

 

**Additional Requirements:**

* Successful candidates must adhere to all safety protocols and proper use of Amrize approved Personal Protection Equipment ("PPE"), including but not limited to respirators. Subject to applicable law, employees that are required to wear respirators must be clean shaven where the respirator seal meets the face in order to pass the qualitative and quantitative fit tests.
 

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Competitive salary
* Savings: Choose from 401(k) pre-tax and/or Roth after-tax savings
* Medical, Dental, Disability and Life Insurance
* Holistic Health & Well-being programs
* Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) & Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) for health and dependent care
* Vision and other Voluntary benefits and discounts
* Paid time off & paid holidays
* Paid Parental Leave (maternity & paternity)
* Educational Assistance Program
* Dress for your day

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Plant manager will provide leadership and direction to ensure the continual, efficient and uniform operation which will meet or exceed customer expectations in a safe and orderly manner.
 
He/she will develop and implement plans coordinated with the Corporate Business Plan to increase the reliability and continually improve the quality and efficiencies of the products and services provided by the business unit.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Supervise branch production using RMAS Warehouse Management System and available Production Planning tools
* Develop plans and procedures to insure the safety of all employees and visitors of the warehouse and Clarify and correct any incorrect warehouse procedures
* Ensure operations and equipment is in compliance to corporate guidelines and OSHA Standards
* Verify inventory and make adjustments where necessary
* Hire, train and motivate warehouse employees to build bench strength and increase retention by scheduling and provide training for growth and compliance
* Maintain equipment to provide maximum availability and minimum down time
* Evaluate and recommend new equipment purchases to enhance quality, capabilities and productivity
* Communicate and monitor progress towards company safety, returns and allowances, and on time shipment and delivery directives
* Responsible for building maintenance and security
* Monitor quality and process improvement throughout the warehouse using SAP reports
* Ensure that preventive and corrective action methods are followed to eliminate or correct procedures and practices which do not meet customer requirements
* Follow progressive disciplinary action to adhere to policy and procedures
* Ensure adequate support of the sales department and its customers in a timely and orderly manner
* Assist with customer problems, including on-site visits where necessary
* Facilitate Lean practices in the Plant
* Purchase or direct the purchase of necessary warehouse supplies to insure the ability to comply with written work instructions and customer requirements
* Attend regional and corporate meetings when required
* Perform employee reviews as required
* Assist in contract negotiations, where applicable
* This is a position that works directly on the warehouse floor on or around heavy machinery
* Meets TKMNA Employee Attributes/Competencies

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirement for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements.

**This position has been identified as** **“safety sensitive”** **by thyssenkrupp under applicable laws. Accordingly, any application for this position that is considered for employment with thyssenkrupp requires successful completion of pre-employment drug testing, which may include testing for marijuana in accordance with any applicable federal, state, and local laws.**

**Qualifications:**

Minimum Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree preferred (in a Business, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and Behavioral Science curriculum)
* Two years direct Warehouse Supervision or team leadership, experience
* Proficiency with Microsoft Project, Office application, Excel, Word, Access and PowerPoint a must
* An understanding of Basic Lean Manufacturing Principles
* Safety Mindset

Preferred Requirements:

* MBA, Master’s degree or Ph.D. is a plus
* Exposure to labor relations, safety programs, ISO standards, Lean practices and sale functions.
* This individual must also possess good leadership qualities and the ability to build an effective team as well as be an effective team member

Up to $119K-$147K annually

* Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance

* Tuition Reimbursement
* And more!

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Lead Operations. Build Teams. Drive Growth.**

Are you a hands-on operations leader who thrives on building high-performing teams, improving processes, and delivering results? UFP Factory Built is looking for a Plant Manager to lead one of our manufacturing facilities and play a key role in the success of our growing business.

 

As a Plant Manager, you'll have the opportunity to run the operation like it's your own, leading production, safety, quality, inventory, maintenance, and team development while making a direct impact on profitability and customer satisfaction. This is an ideal role for a leader who enjoys solving problems, developing people, and creating a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

**About UFP Factory Built**

UFP Factory Built, a division of UFP Industries, supplies structural components and engineered solutions for manufactured housing, modular construction, RV, and cargo trailer manufacturers throughout North America. We are part of a stable, growth-oriented organization with a strong reputation for investing in our people and promoting from within.

 

### **What You'll Do**

* Lead all day-to-day plant operations, ensuring safety, quality, productivity, and profitability goals are achieved.
* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of supervisors and production employees.
* Drive operational excellence through process improvements, waste reduction, and efficiency initiatives.
* Manage production scheduling, inventory levels, shipping activities, and resource planning.
* Monitor key performance metrics and take action to improve throughput, quality, and financial results.
* Partner with leadership on capital investments, facility improvements, and business growth initiatives.
* Foster a culture centered around safety, employee engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, OSHA standards, and all applicable regulations.
Oversee maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and minimize downtime. 

 

### **What We're Looking For**

* Experience leading manufacturing, production, operations, or industrial teams.
* Proven ability to motivate employees, develop talent, and drive results.
* Strong business acumen with experience managing budgets, costs, and operational metrics.
* Ability to identify opportunities, solve problems, and implement effective solutions.
* Experience with inventory management, production scheduling, and process improvement.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Forklift certification or willingness to obtain certification. 

 

### **Why Join UFP?**

* Opportunity to lead and influence all aspects of a manufacturing operation.
* High visibility and direct impact on business performance.
* Stable and growing company with a strong national footprint.
* Collaborative culture that values leadership, innovation, and accountability.
* Career advancement opportunities within UFP Industries.
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package. 

 

### **What Success Looks Like**

In this role, you'll build a safe, efficient, and engaged operation, develop future leaders, improve plant performance, and help position the facility for continued growth. You'll have the autonomy to make decisions, the support of an experienced leadership team, and the opportunity to leave a lasting impact on the business.

 

**If you're a driven operations leader looking to take ownership of a facility, develop teams, and grow your career with an industry leader, we'd love to hear from you.**

**Benefits** **currently offered to our employees:**

* Medical Insurance
* Health Savings Account with Company Contribution
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Basic and Voluntary Life Insurance
* Disability Insurance
* 401(k) plan with Company Match
* Paid Vacation and Holidays
* Stock Purchase Program with Employee Discount
* Education Reimbursement
* Wellness Programs and Challenges
Other Supplemental Benefits 

*The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

new_roles.title: Slag Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
Line of Business: Cement & White

### **About Us**

Heidelberg Materials is one of the world's largest suppliers of building materials. Heidelberg Materials North America operates over 450 locations across the U.S. and Canada with approximately 9,000 employees.

 

The Plant Manager role is based at our slag grinding facility in Cape Canaveral, FL and reports directly to the Vice President of Cement Operations.

 

### **What You’ll Be Doing**

 

* Leads plant safety program to ensure a safe working environment. Ensures all company safety policies are implemented and followed.

* Actively participate in the development of the plant’s objectives and oversee all aspects of daily plant production and maintenance activities to optimize plant performance.

* Provide input into plant capital plan and operation plan and effectively manage budget costs.

* Plans, coordinates and directs all production activities to ensure that Plant Operations goals and targets are realized.

* Analyzes plant activities on a daily basis to assess and recommend areas for improvements in production, quality or efficiency.

* Synchronizes production activities with quarry, maintenance, process and quality control activities to make certain that the plant is performing to highest standards.

* Manages the team to ensure production requirements are met.

* Oversee plant maintenance.

* Ensure that the maintenance and operation of equipment is at optimal levels.

* Guides and directs maintenance managers to minimize equipment downtime.

* Plans, organizes and oversees the annual plant shut down.

* Ensures HTC Maintenance initiatives are implemented.

* Leads and fosters the collaborative efforts of the plant staff to address operating methods, procedures, and problems toward continuous improvement of production quality and efficiency. Identifies training needs of plant staff and ensures that appropriate training is implemented.

* Fully support the company’s purchasing initiative and ensure that purchasing policies and contract management policies and procedures are adhered to in the plant.

* Work in partnership with Plant Purchasing personnel regarding the purchase of major equipment.

* In collaboration with Sales and Marketing stay abreast of customer requirements and concerns.

* Determine and oversee the timely resolution to issues stemming from production, quality, etc.

* Participate in community activities to continually promote plant/community relations.

* Works with the plant Quality Control Department to meet product specifications and production goals

* Ensure compliance with plant policies & procedures, safety, environmental, state and federal process regulations.

* Ensure implementation of company policies and procedures.

* Responsible for the flawless execution of the Plant on call schedule, participating as needed.

* Leads and fosters the collaborative efforts of the plant staff to address operating methods, procedures, and problems toward continuous improvement of production quality and efficiency.

### **What Are We Looking For**

* A College Degree in Engineering or related field.

* 5 or more years progressive experience managing operations in a slag grinding facility

* Synchronize production activities with quarry, maintenance, process and quality control activities to make certain that the plant is performing to highest standards.

* Manage the team to ensure production requirements are met.

* Oversee plant maintenance.

* Ensure that the maintenance and operation of equipment is at optimal levels.

* Guide and direct maintenance manager to minimize equipment downtime.

* In coordination with Plant Management, plan, organizes and oversee the annual plant shut down.

* Ensure HTC Maintenance initiatives are implemented.

* A high level of technical knowledge related to all aspects of cement manufacturing

* Familiar with Central Control operations, including the process control system in a preheater plant with a pre-calciner and alternate fuels experience an asset.

* Managerial and leadership competencies acquired in progressively more responsible positions in a non-unionized plant with the ability to perform in roles of both plant manager and direct reports on a relief basis.

* Ability to make timely, critical decisions, often under conditions of uncertainty and stress.

* Detailed knowledge about process equipment interlocking; Knowledge in mill liner installation and ball charge design.

* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

* Proficient with windows-based PC software programs including MS Office, SAP and other applicable software programs.

* Ability to read and understand financial statements and cost reports, prepare budget and forecasts and to focus on and manage costs.

* Strong interpersonal, leadership and motivational skills.

* Ability to communicate effectively and interact as a team member in a Total Quality environment

### **What We Offer**

 

* Competitive base salary, $139,100 to $185,460 annually and participation in our annual incentive plan.
* 401(k) retirement savings plan with an automatic company contribution as well as matching contributions.
* Highly competitive benefits programs, including:

* + Medical, Dental, and Vision along with Prescription Drug Benefits
 + Health Savings Account (HSA), Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
 + AD&D, Short- and Long-Term Disability Coverage as well as Basic Life Insurance
 + Paid Bonding Leave, 15 days of Paid Vacation, 40 hours of Paid Sick Leave and 10 Paid Holidays

Equal Opportunity Employer - Minority / Female / Veteran / Disabled.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
### **At Materion, everyone is included, respected and offered opportunity to grow.** ***Join us!***

**Position Summary**
====================

The Director of Operations, Premium Targets provides strategic and operational leadership for a complex, multi-site manufacturing organization with domestic and international operations. This leader is accountable for safety, quality, delivery, cost, customer performance, talent development, capital execution, and continuous improvement. The individual in this role will lead Operations, Supply Chain, and Engineering teams, including manufacturing facilities across multiple locations. As the organization’s senior operations safety leader, the Director sets clear expectations, models visible safety leadership, empowers employees to identify and address hazards, and holds leaders accountable for proactive risk reduction and continuous EHS improvement. Working across Technology, Quality, Supply Chain, Commercial, Engineering, EHS, and other functions, the Director translates business priorities into sustainable results, standardizes manufacturing and business processes, and delivers exceptional service to internal and external customers. The role also leads operations strategy and financial performance, including gross margin, inventory turns, and cost management.

**Operations Leadership and Execution**
=======================================

* Lead a proactive, prevention-focused safety culture in which every employee is empowered and expected to identify hazards, stop unsafe work, and take ownership of a safe and healthy workplace.
* Lead manufacturing operations across Buffalo, Wheatfield, Albuquerque, Limerick, and Brewster, with strong matrix partnerships supporting Alzenau and Taiwan.
* Own performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, reliability, and customer commitments; establish clear metrics, review performance routinely, and hold site leaders accountable for results.
* Set and execute the Premium Targets operations strategy, multi-year roadmap, and long-range capital and workforce plans.
* Ensure facilities consistently deliver high-quality products on time to internal business units and external customers.
* Partner with Technology, Quality, Supply Chain, Commercial, Engineering, EHS, and other functions to align priorities and improve end-to-end performance.
* Develop, coach, and hold operational leaders accountable for business results, team effectiveness, and talent growth.
* Strengthen communication, operating discipline, and knowledge sharing across all Premium Targets facilities.
* Provide clear, timely business updates and recommendations to senior leaders and key stakeholders.

**Operational Excellence, Strategy, and Capital Leadership**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Champion EHS excellence by ensuring regulatory compliance, audit readiness, effective risk assessments, timely incident and near-miss investigation, corrective-action closure, and consistent use of leading and lagging safety indicators.
* Serve as executive sponsor for the Premium Targets Lean manufacturing transformation.
* Advance daily management, structured problem solving, kaizen, standard work, process improvement, and cost-reduction practices across sites.
* Partner with Lean resources and site leaders to implement improvements and sustain measurable gains.
* Lead major capital programs, equipment installations, expansions, and facility transitions in partnership with Engineering, corporate, business-unit, and capital teams.
* Ensure capital initiatives meet approved cost, schedule, quality, and performance objectives while integrating safety into design, installation, commissioning, and startup.
* Develop manufacturing and supply chain strategies that support production, maintenance, planning, EHS, technical capability, and customer requirements.
* Partner with Commercial teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
* Enable best-practice sharing and process standardization across manufacturing locations.
* Lead financial performance improvement, with a focus on gross margin, inventory turns, and cost management.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, business, or a related field.
* At least 10 years of progressive experience in a manufacturing environment, including significant manufacturing operations people leadership responsibility with a demonstrated ability to develop leaders and build high-performing teams.
* Demonstrated success leading safety and EHS performance, manufacturing operations, continuous improvement, engineering, and capital projects.
* Ability to lead end-to-end processes and deliver results through cross-functional and matrixed teams.
* Ability to travel up to 50%.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in engineering, business administration, or a related field.
* Leadership experience in a multi-site or international manufacturing organization.
* Experience leading a Lean transformation or enterprise-wide operating system.
* Experience managing major capital programs, facility expansions, installations, or transitions.

**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic and systems-oriented thinking, with the ability to translate business priorities into executable operating plans.
* Strong influence, collaboration, and negotiation skills, including the ability to secure alignment and resources across functions.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication with team members, peers, customers, and senior leaders.
* Sound judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguity, reconcile differing viewpoints, and make timely decisions.
* Visible, values-based leadership grounded in safety, integrity, accountability, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated commitment to coaching, succession planning, and the growth of talent across all levels.

Pay Range:

$148,500.00 - $237,100.00

*Actual base salary offered varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location.*

**The selection of the person to be hired for this position is contingent on the candidate having export compliance eligibility for access to U.S. controlled technology which comes under the licensing jurisdiction of the U.S. Department of State, International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the U.S. Department of Commerce, Export Administration Regulations (EAR).**

**The candidate selected will have to qualify as either a U.S. citizen, a U.S. National, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., a Person Admitted into the U.S. as an Asylee or Refugee., a National of a country that is not prohibited from having access to U.S. controlled technology (via a letter of assurance), or a Person to be approved for an export license by the governing agency whose technology comes under its jurisdiction. Please understand that any job offer that requires approval of an export license will be conditional on Materion’s determination that it will be able to obtain an export license in a time frame consistent with Materion’s business requirements.**

It is the Company’s policy to not unlawfully discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances. new_roles.title: Sr. Director Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Company Description**

At **Link Snacks**, we show up hungry, roll up our sleeves, plaid or otherwise, and dive straight into the hard work. We don’t hide from challenges; we hunt them down. We push harder, move faster, and take the kinds of big swings that built this business in the North Woods of Wisconsin four decades ago.

We’re everyday people who deliver extraordinary results. Innovation, creativity, and urgency aren’t buzzwords, they’re expectations. And just like the real protein snacks we make across our global house of brands—Jack Link’s®*,* Lorissa’s Kitchen®*,* Golden Island®*,* BiFi®*, and* Peperami® *and* KOOEE!® to name a few—there’s nothing artificial about us. What you see is exactly what you get: humble, gritty, passionate people who show up every day ready to not just be a participate in the meat snack industry that the Link Family created, but to move faster, innovate harder and keep raising the bar so high, the rest of the world needs a ladder just to see it.

Dominating this space across the world takes a team. A team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. A team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Sr Director of Operational Excellence leads the company's continuous improvement strategy across all manufacturing sites. This role will build the process, capabilities, tools, and governance necessary to create a consistent and sustainable approach to continuous improvement across all factories. The Sr Director will establish a standardized manufacturing excellence framework grounded in lean principles, structured problem solving, loss elimination, standard work, and performance management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the CI change effort. Develop and lead the company’s Continuous Improvement strategy and roadmap across all factories.
* Establish a common CI methodology, tools, governance, terminology, and expectations across the manufacturing network.
* Establish common standards for Lean practices, structured problem solving, daily management, standard work, and performance improvement.
* Establish and advance Lean manufacturing practices including standard work, Kaizen, 5S, value-stream mapping, visual management, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, centerlining, and structured problem solving.
* Develop CI training, tools, playbooks and learning programs.
* Develop a network of plant-level Continuous Improvement champions to accelerate adoption and share knowledge.
* Manage performance. Work with the Plant Leadership Team to track plant targets and KPIs regularly and set action plans and follow-up meetings to close gaps.
* Own KPI visibility. Manage the daily, weekly, and monthly KPI charting and posting process to keep teams accountable.
* Simplify data. Use Power BI and SAP to turn complex operational data into clear, usable information for plant and operations leaders.
* Apply analytics. Use statistics and other analytical methods to identify improvement opportunities and support decisions.
* Track savings. Implement and manage a cost savings tracking process aligned with corporate standards and deliver against savings targets.
* Partner on safety. Partner with the Safety Director to embed safety into improvement work, including incident investigation, hazard reduction, and safety considerations in kaizen events.
* Perform other duties as assigned

 
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in operations, manufacturing, supply chain, business, engineering, food science, or related field, or equivalent experience in continuous improvement.
* 7 to 10 years experience in a manufacturing environment, including a leadership role.
* 5+ years in influencing roles, such as CI, Lean, or support functions.
* Experience or education in statistical process control, root cause analysis, or other analytical methods.
* Training and hands-on experience with value stream mapping, kaizen methods, 5S, leader standard work, and other Lean tools.
* Project management experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver on timelines, budgets, and goals.
* Experience developing or implementing a playbook for a management operating system (MOS) and a continuous improvement program, including how the playbook was rolled out across sites.

**Preferred**

* Experience with SAP and Power BI for operational reporting.
* Experience in food or consumer packaged goods manufacturing.
* Experience with Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), with at least working exposure to its Autonomous Maintenance (AM) and Planned Maintenance (PM) pillars.

**Skill and Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence leaders at every level.
* Diplomacy in communicating needs and recommendations, with credibility that earns trust across functions.
* A proactive style that drives projects to completion despite obstacles.
* A collaborative team approach in all situations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams at once.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

 **Additional Information**

*The salary range for this role is $195,000 - 225,000 annually*

Link Snacks provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Employer** 
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

new_roles.title: Quality Control - Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
Stanton is the leading designer and supplier of decorative high quality self-branded carpet, custom fabricated rugs and hard surfaces. Stanton sells its products across the mid to high end residential as well as decorative commercial marketplaces. Stanton is rated #1 Favorite Area Rug Manufacturer for Style, Quality & Service and Top 5 Favorite Carpet Manufacturer among our customers in Floor Focus magazine.
 
 
Stanton is seeking a strategic and technical Director of Quality Control for our Calhoun GA location. This leader will drive the strategic development of a global supplier management program, ensuring that every sourced product meets clearly defined performance criteria and customer expectations. Through thorough vetting and continuous performance monitoring, you will minimize risk and foster a culture of quality excellence. This role is pivotal in upholding Stanton’s commitment to excellence, ensuring our entire product portfolio delivers uncompromised quality, integrity, and performance from the source to the end customer.
 
 
**Responsibilities Include: (but not limited to):** 
Strategic Quality Systems & Standards
 

* Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive Quality Management System (QMS) to track, report, and resolve quality issues across all product lines (carpets, rugs, and hard surfaces).
* Oversee internal and external audits to ensure strict adherence to industry regulations, ISO 9001 standards, and accrediting agency requirements.
* Drive risk avoidance through rigorous and thorough vetting of product quality, performance, and adherence to industry and global standards.

Global Supplier Management & Partnering
 

* Establish and maintain strategic relationships with vendors and manufacturers; monitor supplier performance and evaluate auditing processes to ensure global supply chain adherence.
* Develop and maintain data-driven supplier scorecards to measure and improve quality performance.
* Lead the vetting process for global product suppliers to ensure clearly defined fitness-for-use criteria.

Technical Integrity & Continuous Improvement
 

* Direct testing procedures and routine inspections to assess raw materials and finished products, ensuring durability, aesthetic, and functional specifications are met.
* Lead root-cause analyses and develop Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) plans using Six Sigma or Lean methodologies to eliminate defects and improve efficiency.
* Analyze and report on quality metrics, trends, and performance to executive leadership and regulatory agencies as required.

Operational Oversight & Fiscal Responsibility
 

* Provide complete oversight and management of all downgraded inventory.
* Manage supplier chargebacks, ensuring financial accountability for quality failures.

Leadership & Organizational Culture
 

* Recruit, train, and manage Quality Control personnel, providing oversight of multiple QC inspectors daily.
* Conduct performance evaluations and foster a culture of quality, integrity, and performance excellence within the team.

**Qualifications Include:** 

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Quality Management, or a related industrial/scientific field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* 8 to 10+ years of progressive, hands-on quality control/assurance management experience.
* Strong understanding of machine and hand-woven carpet manufacturing process.
* Strong understanding of all hard surface manufacturing.
* Working knowledge of installation procedures.
* Proven expertise in quality control methodologies such as Six Sigma or Lean.
* Deep knowledge of standards such as ISO 9001 and experience with quality management software.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a track record of successful process improvement initiatives.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to train staff and liaise with external parties.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a strategic team.
* Physical Requirements: Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer; must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times to inspect product samples.

new_roles.title: Quality Director
new_roles.description:
**Quality Director**
--------------------

Department: Quality Assurance / Quality Control

Reports To: Executive Leadership

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: INOX SOLAR Manufacturing Facility

**Job** **Summary**
-------------------

The Director of Quality is responsible for leading and overseeing all quality assurance and quality control activities at INOX SOLAR USA. This position ensures that solar modules, manufacturing processes, raw materials, and finished products meet established quality standards, customer requirements, applicable regulatory requirements, and company specifications.

The Quality Director develops and implements quality management systems, drives continuous improvement initiatives, leads quality investigations, and partners with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Supply Chain, and executive leadership to reduce defects, improve product reliability, and maintain consistent manufacturing performance.

**Essential** **Duties** **and** **Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------------------

### **1.** **Quality** **Leadership** **and** **Strategy**

* Develop and implement the company's overall quality strategy, objectives, policies, and procedures.
* Establish quality performance metrics, key performance indicators (KPIs), and departmental goals.
* Lead the Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams, including inspectors, technicians, engineers, and supervisors.
* Establish accountability for quality performance across all manufacturing departments.
* Provide regular quality performance reports, trend analyses, and improvement recommendations to executive leadership.
* Promote a culture of quality, accountability, safety, and continuous improvement.

### **2.** **Quality** **Management** **Systems** **and** **Compliance**

* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve the Quality Management System (QMS).
* Ensure compliance with applicable ISO standards, customer specifications, industry requirements, and internal quality procedures.
* Maintain controlled quality documentation, inspection records, work instructions, and standard operating procedures.
* Lead internal audits, support external audits, and coordinate corrective actions resulting from audit findings.
* Maintain appropriate records to support product traceability, quality investigations, and compliance requirements.
* Coordinate quality certification activities and customer or third-party audits as applicable.

### **3.** **Solar** **Module** **Manufacturing** **Quality**

* Oversee quality throughout the solar module manufacturing process, from incoming materials to final product release.
* Establish and maintain inspection standards for incoming materials, in-process production, and finished solar modules.
* Monitor manufacturing quality at critical production stages, including cell handling, stringing, layup, lamination, framing, junction box installation, EL testing, final inspection, and packaging.
* Ensure effective implementation of electroluminescence (EL) testing, visual inspections, electrical performance testing, and other required quality verification activities.
* Investigate manufacturing defects, process deviations, nonconforming products, and recurring quality issues.
* Work with Production and Engineering to identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Establish procedures for product identification, traceability, nonconforming material control, and final product release.

### **4.** **Quality** **Control** **and** **Performance** **Improvement**

* Establish and monitor quality KPIs, including defect rates, first-pass yield, scrap rates, rework, customer complaints, and corrective action closure.
* Analyze quality data to identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead root cause analysis using appropriate methodologies, such as 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagrams, and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA).
* Implement corrective and preventive action processes to prevent recurrence of quality issues.
* Partner with Production and Engineering to improve process capability, reduce variation, and minimize manufacturing losses.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve product quality, manufacturing efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

### **5.** **Supplier** **and** **Incoming** **Quality** **Management**

* Establish supplier quality standards and incoming material inspection requirements.
* Collaborate with Purchasing, Supply Chain, and Engineering to evaluate supplier quality performance.
* Lead supplier corrective action requests and investigations involving defective or nonconforming materials.
* Monitor supplier quality trends and recommend supplier improvement plans when necessary.
* Support supplier audits, qualification activities, and ongoing supplier performance reviews.

### **6.** **Customer** **Quality** **and** **Product** **Reliability**

* Serve as the senior point of contact for significant customer quality concerns and escalations.
* Oversee investigations into customer complaints, product defects, and warranty-related quality issues.
* Coordinate corrective action responses and ensure timely resolution of customer concerns.
* Prepare quality reports and technical documentation for customers and executive leadership.
* Collaborate with relevant departments to identify opportunities to improve product reliability and customer satisfaction.
* Support product testing, validation, and quality requirements associated with new products and manufacturing process changes.

### **7.** **Leadership** **and** **Team** **Development**

* Recruit, develop, coach, and evaluate Quality Department employees.
* Establish clear departmental responsibilities, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Provide training on quality standards, inspection procedures, documentation, and problem-solving methods.
* Ensure adequate staffing, equipment, and resources to support production quality requirements.
* Collaborate with department leaders to address quality issues and strengthen cross-functional communication.
* Encourage employees to identify quality risks and take appropriate action to prevent defects.

### **8.** **Risk** **Management** **and** **Continuous** **Improvement**

* Identify and evaluate risks that could affect product quality, reliability, safety, or customer satisfaction.
* Implement preventive controls to reduce the likelihood of manufacturing defects and product failures.
* Review quality risks associated with new equipment, process changes, materials, and product designs.
* Support change management processes to ensure changes are properly reviewed, validated, documented, and approved.
* Monitor emerging quality concerns and recommend appropriate preventive measures.
* Ensure lessons learned from quality incidents are incorporated into manufacturing procedures and employee training.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Quality Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field required.
* Master's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or Business Administration preferred.

### **Experience**

* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in quality assurance, quality control, or manufacturing quality management.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing quality teams or departments.
* Experience in solar module manufacturing, photovoltaic production, electronics manufacturing, or a related manufacturing environment strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and maintaining quality management systems.
* Experience leading internal and external audits, root cause investigations, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience managing customer quality concerns, supplier quality issues, and manufacturing process improvements.

### **Technical** **Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and ISO 9001 requirements.
* Familiarity with applicable photovoltaic module standards, such as IEC 61215 and IEC 61730, as relevant to the company's products and markets.
* Knowledge of manufacturing inspection methods, product testing, defect analysis, and quality documentation.
* Experience with root cause analysis, CAPA, FMEA, statistical process control (SPC), and other quality improvement methodologies.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and quality reporting or manufacturing data systems.
* Ability to analyze complex quality data and translate findings into actionable improvement plans.

**Core** **Competencies**
-------------------------

* Strategic leadership and decision-making
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Attention to detail and commitment to product quality
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Effective communication and presentation skills
* Employee development and team management
* Risk assessment and corrective action management
* Continuous improvement and process optimization
* Customer focus and accountability

**Performance** **Measures** **(KPIs)**
---------------------------------------

The Director of Quality will be evaluated based on performance against established departmental and company goals, including:

* First-pass yield and overall production yield
* Manufacturing defect and nonconformance rates
* Scrap and rework reduction
* Customer complaints and warranty-related quality trends
* Corrective and preventive action closure rates
* Supplier defect rates and supplier corrective action performance
* Internal and external audit results
* Quality documentation accuracy and compliance
* Employee training completion and team performance
* Progress toward continuous improvement and product reliability goals

**Working** **Conditions**
--------------------------

* Work is performed in both an office and manufacturing environment.
* Regular presence on the production floor is required to monitor quality performance and support investigations.
* Must be able to work collaboratively with production personnel, engineers, technicians, suppliers, customers, and executive leadership.
* May require occasional extended hours or schedule flexibility to address significant quality issues, production concerns, audits, or customer escalations.
* Must comply with applicable company safety policies and manufacturing facility requirements.

**Equal** **Employment** **Opportunity**
----------------------------------------

INOX SOLAR is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

new_roles.title: Manufacturing Execution Systems Senior Manager
new_roles.description:
Ready to join a global leader in air movement and ventilation? At Greenheck Group, joining our team means more than just starting a job, it’s joining an award-winning culture prioritizing your growth and development. Our unwavering commitment in supporting our team members both personally and professionally has earned us national recognition time and time again. As an innovative, environmentally responsible manufacturer of commercial HVAC systems, Greenheck Group designs and manufactures industry-leading air movement and ventilation solutions through our family of trusted brands. Our products are found in commercial, institutional, and industrial facilities worldwide, from schools and hospitals to factories and stadiums. Since 1947, we’ve proudly invested in our people and our communities, fostering innovation, leadership, and opportunity at every level. We are more than products, we are a team of inspired people doing extraordinary things.

As a Manufacturing Execution Systems Senior Manager for Greenheck Group you will own product strategy and delivery across Greenheck Group’s full manufacturing-systems portfolio — Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), maintenance management, machine integration, machine/production monitoring (MDC), and automation. You will serve as the senior product leader for Manufacturing Execution Systems, directly leading the MES functional lead team, owning the roadmap for the Critical Manufacturing platform consolidation, and establishing enterprise standards and consistency for manufacturing technology across Greenheck Group’s plants. You will operate as the critical connective link between enterprise manufacturing systems and the business, IT, Divisional Systems teams, and the broader Operational Systems/CoE community.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**

* Program Leadership: Own the product roadmap and delivery across the full manufacturing-systems portfolio — MES, maintenance management, machine integration, machine/production monitoring (MDC), and automation — across all Greenheck production sites. Lead the end-to-end roadmap for the Critical Manufacturing platform consolidation, replacing legacy custom integrations and MII applications across Greenheck's production sites. Coordinate cross-functional teams, allocate resources, and co-manage project timelines with Program Management. Drive accountability throughout execution and establish aggressive, results-oriented goals for the team.
* Divisional & CoE Alignment: Serve as the critical point of alignment between enterprise MES capabilities and divisional/plant-level execution — partnering closely with the business, IT, Divisional Systems teams, and the other Operational Systems/CoE groups (e.g., Operational Excellence, Machine Automation/MDC) to ensure enterprise standards translate into plant-level adoption and results.
* Team Leadership: Build and lead the MES functional lead team across the MES, maintenance, machine integration, monitoring, and automation domains.
* Change Leadership: Facilitate organizational change related to MES and manufacturing-systems adoption; communicate to create buy-in and promote system acceptance across plant floors.
* Standards and Consistency: Drive manufacturing-systems standards and consistency across Greenheck production sites through an MES steering committee and governance framework spanning MES, maintenance, machine integration, monitoring, and automation.
* Communication: Provide status updates on timeline, cost, and risk to the Operational Systems and OT Executive Steering Committees; communicate with team, stakeholders, and senior/executive leaders.
* Strategic Planning: Set the vision and develop and execute a comprehensive manufacturing-systems strategy aligned with organizational goals; identify opportunities for process improvement, efficiency gains, and cost reduction across MES, maintenance, machine integration, monitoring, and automation.
* Collaboration: Work closely with the Sr Manager, ERP and Program/Project Management on shared roadmap, resourcing, and delivery dependencies; partner with external resources to ensure manufacturing systems align with business objectives.
* Best Practices: Stay current on MES, automation, and manufacturing-technology trends and bring forward platform recommendations.

**WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE AS A MANUFACTURING EXECUTION SYSTEMS SENIOR MANAGER**

* 4 Year / bachelor’s degree in engineering, information systems, business, or a related field required
* Graduate Degree in engineering, information systems, or related field preferred
* 4-6 years of relevant work experience in MES implementation, project management or related fields required
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and production environments required
* Certification in project management preferred
* Experience with MES systems and their integration with ERP preferred
* 80/20 thinking
* Manufacturing experience and credibility
* Strong team building and leadership
* Systems and technology savvy
* Strategic thinking and leadership
* Action-oriented

**SOME THINGS WE THINK YOU SHOULD KNOW**

* Travel of 10 to 25% will be required for this role.
* This is an on-site role at our Schofield, WI location.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

Greenheck Group takes pride in providing competitive total compensation along with a comprehensive benefits package as part of our total rewards program. The compensation for this role includes base salary along with the opportunity to earn additional variable compensation based on achieving specific performance metrics. The starting base pay range for this position is $160,353 - $198,083 and may vary based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and performance.

 

With best-in-class benefits, you can be the best you, and together, we can be the best in the industry. Visit our **Perks & Benefits page** for more information on these offerings:

 

* Health & Family Support
* Financial Security
* Learning & Development
* Rewards & Recognition
* Wellbeing & Mental Health
* Work-Life Balance
* Fun Perks

**SPECIAL NOTATION**

The preceding statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people in this position. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills. The Employer retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

Work is performed in an office environment and requires the ability to operate standard office equipment, such as a computer and phone. Sedentary work. Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. Repetitive motion. Substantial motions of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. The person is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data, and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading. Occasional mobility required to attend in-person meetings and complete various office tasks.

**EEO STATEMENT**

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

**ACCOMMODATIONS REQUEST**

Greenheck Group complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and candidates with disabilities. To request an accommodation for the application or interview process, please email HR@greenheck.com with your name, job title, posting number, and requested accommodation.

**RECRUITING FRAUD ALERT**

At Greenheck Group, your personal information and online safety are our top priorities. Our recruiters will only direct candidates to apply through our official career page at https://greenheckgroup.com/careers/. We will never request payments, financial account details, or sensitive information such as Social Security numbers. If you’re unsure about the legitimacy of a message, please contact HR@greenheck.com for verification.

If you're looking for a place to grow while working with happy, enthusiastic, values-based people, you'll enjoy your career with us!

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Operations
new_roles.description:
Since 2018, Elevate Aircraft Seating has been enhancing the passenger experience through innovative aircraft seat design and manufacturing. With locations in California, Washington, and Germany we are guided by creativity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to quality.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Manager Operations to join our team in Santa Maria, CA. This is an on-site position based in Santa Maria, CA. We value teamwork, inclusivity, and continuous professional development, and we offer competitive benefits along with opportunities for growth.

**Export Control Requirements:**

**This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager, Operations is responsible for leading and overseeing manufacturing operations and maintenance activities to ensure the achievement of safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost objectives. This role drives operational performance through effective resource planning, workforce development, and process optimization while supporting continuous improvement initiatives. Partnering cross-functionally, the Senior Manager implements operational strategies, promotes accountability, and ensures efficient manufacturing execution aligned with organizational and customer objectives.

**SUMMARY OF JOB DUTIES** - **Essential Functions****(Other duties and projects may be assigned or requested.)**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions*

**Operational Leadership & Performance**

* Lead and oversee daily manufacturing operations and maintenance activities to achieve safety, quality, on-time delivery, productivity, labor efficiency, scrap reduction, and work-in-process (WIP) inventory objectives.
* Establish, monitor, and drive accountability for key operational performance indicators (KPIs), implementing corrective actions to address performance gaps.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying operational inefficiencies, collaborating with relevant stakeholders, and implementing improvements within manufacturing operations.

**Production Planning & Execution**

* Oversee all phases of manufacturing operations to ensure production activities comply with established procedures, quality standards, and approved manufacturing processes.
* Plan, coordinate, and optimize departmental activities, production schedules, and resource allocation to meet customer requirements and business objectives.
* Evaluate production capacity, workforce requirements, and operational constraints to ensure effective utilization of labor, equipment, and manufacturing resources.

**People Leadership & Workforce Development**

* Lead, develop, and manage production and associated functional teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and operational excellence.
* Oversee workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, training, and employee development to maintain operational readiness.
* Establish performance expectations, evaluate employee performance, and partner with Human Resources on coaching, employee relations, corrective actions, and performance management.

**Quality, Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure manufacturing operations adhere to established Quality Management System (QMS) requirements, AS9100 standards, applicable aerospace regulations, and internal policies and procedures.
* Promote a culture of safety, quality, and compliance by ensuring employees are appropriately trained and consistently follow established manufacturing procedures.

**Financial Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Manage departmental budgets, monitor operational expenditures, and implement cost-control measures to support financial objectives.
* Partner with Supply Chain, Planning, Quality, Engineering, Program Management, and other stakeholders to resolve operational challenges, align production priorities, and meet customer delivery commitments.

**Other**

* Maintain a safe, secure and legal work environment, adhering to all Company policies and procedures.
* Protect the confidentiality of the Company’s information and products.
* Contribute to team efforts by performing other job-related duties and projects as assigned or requested.

**GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS – Education, Knowledge, and Experience**

**Education**:

* High School Diploma or GED equivalent required.
* Associate degree, technical/trade certification, or bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

**Experience**:

* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations, including 5+ years in a leadership role overseeing production teams, operational performance, and manufacturing processes.
* Demonstrated success managing manufacturing operations in a complex, quality-driven production environment, with a focus on improving safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost performance.
* Proven ability to lead supervisors or managers, develop high-performing teams, and drive operational improvements across multiple manufacturing functions.

**Skills**:

* Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to develop teams, establish accountability, and manage employee performance.
* Proficiency in manufacturing operations, production planning, workforce allocation, and capacity management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret operational KPIs and implement effective corrective actions.
* Knowledge of budget management, cost control, and resource optimization within a manufacturing environment.
* Effective communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and support business objectives.

**Preferred Skills/Experience:**

* Experience in aerospace manufacturing, aircraft interiors, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments, with knowledge of AS9100 and Quality Management Systems (QMS).
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience utilizing Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and manufacturing performance reporting tools.

**Other**:

* Extended or irregular hours may be required.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.
* Elevate Aircraft Seating is an “at-will” employer; employment is at the mutual consent of both the employee and the employer, and may be terminated at will for any reason, with or without cause, at any time during employment with the Company.
* As business conditions warrant a change in the operating necessities of the Company, all employees are expected to react productively, handle other essential tasks assigned now or in the future.
* Tasks may vary slightly based on products produced at a division.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**CERTIFICATES AND LICENSE**

* N/A

**SUPERVISION PROVIDED TO THE POSITION**

* Direction is provided for assignments in terms of desired outcome (goals), timing and budget.? Work is reviewed or measured in terms of meeting organizational objectives and schedules.

**LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITY**

* Provides leadership, coaching, and direction to operational personnel to achieve organizational goals, operational performance objectives, and budgetary targets. Responsible for employee development, performance management, and building organizational capability.

**PROBLEM SOLVING**

* Develop and implement solutions to complex operational challenges that are consistent with organizational objectives and established business practices.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS** 
*Elevate Aircraft Seating offers competitive wages and benefits to recognize employees for their work. The base pay offered will vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, location, experience and take into account internal equity.*

**Salary Range Transparency:** $125,500 - $185,000

**Featured Benefits:**

* Generous 401(K) matching with immediate eligibility and vesting
* 3 weeks of Paid Time Off
* 12 paid holidays
* Affordable health care plans for yourself and your family
* And so much more!

**Other Perks:**

* Supportive workplace environment with a team-oriented culture
* Potential for growth within organization

At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/

**Job Description:**

**Sr. Manager, External Manufacturing Operations**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

As a **Sr, Manager of External Manufacturing Operations**, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

* Owning the operational performance and strategic relationship of the external manufacturing partners supporting Brookings.
* Maintaining direct accountability for the continuity and availability of externally supplied materials and products required for Brookings manufacturing.
* Ensuring materials are available when needed, meet established specifications, and do not disrupt the manufacturing process.
* Establishing clear expectations for Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) performance across quality, delivery, capacity, cost, responsiveness, compliance, and supply continuity.
* Maintaining visibility to supplier production plans, materials, inventory, logistics, capacity, and constraints.
* Leading rapid response and escalation when supplier quality, capacity, production, logistics, technical, or operational issues threaten Brookings manufacturing.
* Driving containment, recovery, root cause, corrective action, and prevention to ensure issues are sustainably resolved.
* Establishing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across the CMO network.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

 

* Bachelor's degree or higher in (completed and verified prior to start) AND twelve (12) years of combined experience in manufacturing, operations, external manufacturing, supply chain, quality, engineering, planning, and/or procurement

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

 

* Experience managing contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), contract manufacturers, and/or strategic manufacturing suppliers
* Experience supporting medical device manufacturing within a regulated manufacturing environment
* Experience managing supply continuity, CMO capacity, production planning, supplier quality, asset strategy, and/or operational risk

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

 

* Experience applying medical device quality systems and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Experience applying GMP, supplier quality, change control, specifications, CAPA, SCARs, Quality Agreements, and/or regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience developing and executing CMO risk mitigation and business continuity strategies.
* Experience establishing supplier KPI dashboards, scorecards, and executive performance reviews.
* Experience supporting CMO contracts, Quality Agreements, commercial negotiations, and supplier performance management.
* Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, capital expenditure (CapEx) planning, and business case development.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving Manufacturing, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Value Stream Management, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, and/or external partners.
* Experience communicating, negotiating, and presenting recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders.

**Work location:**

* **Hybrid Eligible (Job Duties allow for some remote work but require travel to Brookings and other sites, including suppliers and other Solventum locations)**

**Travel: May include up to 70% domestic/international**

**Relocation Assistance: May be authorized**

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

new_roles.title: Senior Plant Manager - Peach Tree City, GA
new_roles.description:
**WHY DO WE NEED YOU?**

The Senior Plant Manager is responsible for the safe, efficient, and profitable operation of our CertainTeed Roofing manufacturing facility in Peachtree City. Reporting to the Senior Director of Regional Operations, this role provides overall leadership for safety, quality, production, cost, delivery, people development, and sustainability performance.

You will set the vision and culture for the site, align daily operations with business strategy, and lead continuous improvement and long term plant performance. Success in this role requires sound judgment, strong business and people leadership, and the ability to balance workforce engagement, customer expectations, regulatory compliance, and community responsibility.

 **IS THIS JOB FOR YOU?**

**What you will do:**

* Lead all aspects of plant operations, including safety, production, maintenance, quality, logistics, engineering, and environmental performance.
* Build and sustain a strong safety culture where health and safety are integrated into daily decisions and operations.
* Deliver plant performance goals across safety, quality, service, cost, productivity, and profitability.
* Own the plant operating budget, forecasting, cost management, and long range planning.
* Drive continuous improvement through Lean Manufacturing, reliability, process optimization, problem solving, and operational excellence.
* Lead change initiatives and translate business strategy into actionable plant priorities and measurable results.
* Build and develop a high performing leadership team through coaching, feedback, succession planning, and employee development.
* Partner cross functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, R&D, Product Management, and other key stakeholders to support customer and business needs.
* Provide leadership for major capital projects and other strategic plant initiatives.

**What you bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience, required.
* 10+ years of progressive production or operations management experience.
* 5 to 7 years of experience at the Production Manager or Plant Superintendent level preferred.
* Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or Operations Management preferred.
* Strong knowledge of production planning, scheduling, supply chain, budgeting, forecasting, and cost control.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, WCM, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.
* Knowledge of quality management systems, equipment reliability, process optimization, OSHA requirements, and safety practices.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem solving, and change management skills.
* Ability to travel domestically approximately 20% of the time.

 
**A LITTLE MORE ABOUT US**

Through the responsible development of innovative and sustainable building products, CertainTeed, headquartered in Malvern, Pennsylvania, has helped shape the building products industry for more than 110 years. Founded in 1904 as General Roofing Manufacturing Company, the company’s slogan, “Quality Made Certain, Satisfaction Guaranteed,” inspired the name CertainTeed. Today, CertainTeed is a leading North American brand of exterior and interior building products, including roofing, siding, trim, insulation, drywall, and ceilings. CertainTeed is a subsidiary of Saint-Gobain, one of the world’s largest and oldest building products companies.

 **LEGAL STATEMENT**

Saint-Gobain provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. Saint-Gobain is an equal opportunity employer of individuals with disabilities and supports the hiring of veterans.

Applicants for roles based in Washington state or remote roles that would be worked from Washington state are encouraged to direct any concerns regarding the state’s Pay Transparency laws to the SGNA HR Compliance team at SGNA\_HR\_Compliance@saint-gobain.com.

 **BENEFITS IN JOINING US**

Saint-Gobain aims to deliver a comprehensive Total Rewards package that supports employees’ wellbeing and helps improve daily life for employees and their families. Be Well. Be You brings together inclusive programs and meaningful resources that support physical, emotional, financial, and social wellbeing. Employees have flexibility to choose the benefits that best fit their individual needs.

Health and wellbeing

* Medical, prescription drug, vision, and dental insurance
* Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options
* LiveWell Wellness Program
* Employee Assistance Program
* Paid time off and paid parental leave

Retirement and protection

* 401(k) with company match and Retirement Accumulation Plan cash balance pension plan
* Company provided life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment insurance, and short term disability
* Voluntary employee and dependent life insurance, long term disability, critical illness insurance, and accident insurance

Additional benefits

* Commuter benefits
* Group legal and identity theft protection
* Auto and home insurance
* Pet insurance and discounts
* Back up child and elder care
* PerkSpot Employee Discount Program
* Volunteer Day
