new_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Quality
new_roles.description:
Who is Swire Coca-Cola? We are a family-owned bottling company with a story spanning over two centuries. We are one of the largest bottlers of Coca-Cola in North America and distribute more than 50 beverage brands and flavors creating joy for our customers every day. Our 8,000+ driven employees work hard as part of a team that delivers refreshment to over 30 million consumers across 13 states. Begin a journey with us at Swire Coca-Cola and belong to a community of dedicated team members who think big and believe in winning together.
 
 
**Job Details:** 
**Job Level:** 7
 
 
**Why you’ll love working at Swire Coca-Cola:** 
Swire Coca-Cola is committed to providing balance to support you in all aspects of your life, both at work and beyond. We offer the benefits you need for physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
 
 

* Health coverage (3 medical options, dental and vision). 401(k) Retirement Plan w/company match
* Health Savings Accounts w/company match
* FREE virtual primary care, acute care and physical therapy
* FREE Employee Assistance Program
* Company paid (vacation, holidays, sick time, bereavement, jury duty, maternity/parental, disability leave and volunteer time)
* Discounted & free product
* Tuition reimbursement
* Opportunities for career advancement

In addition to health benefits, Swire Coca-Cola is proud to offer you opportunities where you help give back directly to the communities and causes you care about. Note: Enrollment in a Swire Medical Plan is required for some benefits.
 
 
What does a Sr. Quality Manager do at Swire Coca-Cola?
 
Lead the Manufacturing Quality discipline at a manufacturing plant level to ensure that plant is operating to the Coca-Cola KORE standards and that all products produced maintain the highest standards of consumer quality for brand integrity.
 
 
**Responsibilities:** 

* Develop, guide and measure the in-plant quality standards that must be met to manufacture products that meet all KO and industry standards for consumer consumption
* Hire, train, and mentor Quality Lab Technicians and Lab/Sanitation Supervisors at the plant level to ensure they are qualified to perform all the quality processes and procedures required to deliver quality product to consumers
* Guide the creation and maintenance of documentation, processes, and procedures to fully comply with all KO KORE standards requirements, as well as any other industry/regulatory requirements for quality in manufacturing at the plant level
* Establish and maintain strong associations with other Coca-Cola bottlers in the Quality Management space in order to effectively learn best practices, provide guidance/counsel where appropriate, and be aware of changing trends and requirements that must be implemented at the plants
* Proactively develop relationships with local and state government agencies responsible for managing water usage and quality standards, discharge standards, etc
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Requirements:** 

* High School Diploma (or GED) required and
* College degree preferred in chemistry, biology, preferred or related science field
* 4+ years' experience in Quality Management in a food manufacturing industry – soft drink preferred
* Strong understanding of the science of soft drink production at the base molecular level
* Strong knowledge of industry quality standards for manufacturing of food grade products
* Specific knowledge of all state and local standards and requirements for water quality and raw materials for food grade production
* KO KORE and ISO quality standards in a soft drink environment

Come and join our Sparkling team!
 
 
Due to the nature of our work and to help maintain a safe workplace for our employees and customers, after a candidate receives a conditional offer of employment, they will be required to complete pre-employment screening. This includes a criminal background check, drug screening, and for certain roles, a motor vehicle record review.
 
 
Screening results are evaluated based on several factors, including the nature and severity of an offense, how much time has passed, the relevance to the position, patterns of repeated offenses, and driving history for roles that require operating a vehicle.
 
 
All results are reviewed fairly and in accordance with applicable state and federal laws, including the Fair Credit Reporting Act.
 
 
Swire Coca-Cola is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer that participates in the E-Verify program as required by law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status or other legally protected characteristics. Swire Coca-Cola does not sponsor applicants for work visas.

new_roles.title: Senior Plant Manager, Contract Logistics Site Operations
new_roles.description:
We are the leading provider of worldwide smart end-to-end supply chain & logistics, enabling the flow of trade across the globe. Our comprehensive range of products and services covers every link of the integrated supply chain – from maritime and inland terminals to marine services and industrial parks as well as technology-driven customer solutions.

* Ensure that customer expectations are met and/or exceeded within the confines of company guidelines
* Quarterly presentations to customer senior management relative to our scorecard and initiatives
* Participate in customer invited meetings e.g. 9:30 am to support Customer strategic objectives
* Communicate with the customer and demonstrate initiatives supporting continuous improvement
* Meet company objectives with respect to Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Morale and Environment
* Quarterly presentations to senior management of DP World re Plant objectives and initiatives
* Establish 5 year / contract life business plan, annual budgets and ensure targets are met
* Local initiatives to ensure plant progression in all regards

ADOPT CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT WITHIN THE WORKPLACE

* Plan and execute the concepts of lean manufacturing
* Ensure the plant plans and executes productivity tasks on an annual and ongoing basis
* Prioritize activities associated with the elimination of waste in all aspects of our operations

ORGANIZATIONAL STRENGTHENING

* Continue to build a stronger salaried team capable of leading the hourly workforce into the demands of the future
* Improve employee relations and morale through participation of personnel from the shop floor and instill behavioral discipline
* Improve communication throughout the organization and at all levels

NEW BUSINESS

* Work with the business development and account management group to identify business opportunities within the capabilities of the plant and local area
* Ensure the plant participates in all activities surrounding potential business and future profitability
* Ensure the plant is always in a state that maximizes its appeal to outsiders and potential customs

BE A CORPORATE CITIZEN, CREATE AN EXTERNAL IMAGE

* Ensure that DP World is a positive force within the community and considered to be a good employer
* Increase the exposure of DP World in a positive light to maximize our opportunity for future growth
* Work with other suppliers and industry focus groups in the local community to learn from their experiences and adapt accordingly

QUALITY & ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS

* Participate as an active member of the management team in supporting ISO 14001 and ensuring that their direct reports abide by these processes and operating work instructions
* Drive, Attend and participate in both ISO TS 16949 and ISO 14001 management review

**QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS**

* A college or university degree related to manufacturing is preferred and /or MBA
* At least seven years of progressively responsible operational leadership experience in logistics, warehousing, manufacturing, or comparable environments, including at least three years managing managers or site leadership teams. Comparable relevant experience may be considered.
* Job experience in a Tier 1 operation is beneficial
* A production, materials and quality control background compliment skill set

***Please note****: This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visas. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in The United States without sponsorship now or in the future.*

**ABOUT DP WORLD**

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 115,000 employees from 160 nationalities, spanning 78 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses - Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.

What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimizing disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.

DP World is on a mission to transcend boundaries and bridge the gap between all nations and cultures – not just in what we do but also in how we behave.

We are dedicated to creating a culture where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that embracing inclusion and diversity, drives innovation and growth and helps us connect people, businesses, and societies. Free minds and different perspectives are changing our world, and together we can change what’s possible.

***WE MAKE TRADE FLOW***

***TO CHANGE WHAT'S POSSIBLE FOR EVERYONE.***

DP World is committed to the principles of Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO). We strongly believe that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success and we make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or belief. 
 
By submitting your resume and application information, you authorize DP World to transmit and store your information in the world-wide recruitment database, and to circulate that information as necessary for the purpose of evaluating your qualifications for this or other job vacancies.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Production Planning & Control (PP&C)
new_roles.description:
**About Hirsh Precision**
-------------------------

Hirsh Precision is a leader in U.S. manufacturing, bringing productivity and product innovation to medical, aerospace, industrial, and scientific markets through software, advanced manufacturing techniques, and modern production systems. Our reputation for integrity, quality, service, and excellence is powered by a passionate, engaged team and a culture focused on work that improves people’s lives.

**Role Snapshot**
-----------------

As the Senior Manager, Production Planning & Control (PP&C), you will orchestrate end-to-end planning operations that keep our factory synchronized—from MRP and buy planning to inventory control, warehousing, and logistics. You’ll shape the planning strategy, lead a high-performing team, and ensure schedules, materials, and capacity align to deliver on time, every time.

### **What you’ll do**

* Own and execute MRP activities, including buy planning, material master data stewardship, warehousing, and logistics coordination.
* Partner closely with Production, Engineering, Quality, and Finance to align planning strategies to business goals.
* Lead continuous improvement to increase affordability while safeguarding performance and quality.
* Build, mentor, and develop a top-performing team through training, coaching, performance assessments, and recognition.
* Create and manage production schedules to optimize capacity utilization and meet on-time delivery commitments.
* Monitor shop orders, production priorities, and work center schedules, adjusting proactively as conditions change.
* Collaborate with Operations, Purchasing, and Sales Operations to anticipate and resolve material, labor, and equipment constraints.
* Act as the primary escalation point for all scheduling-related issues.
* Advance scheduling processes, tools, reporting, and overall efficiency via continuous improvement.
* Maintain pristine scheduling data integrity within BPCS and generate KPI dashboards, performance reports, and metrics.
* Provide senior-level insights and reporting to executive stakeholders.

### **A week in the role might look like**

* Kick off with an S&OP alignment touchpoint; validate demand signals and capacity models.
* Review MRP outputs; firm planned orders and buy plans; resolve exceptions with Purchasing.
* Walk the floor with Operations to assess bottlenecks; rebalance work center loads and update priorities.
* Host a cross-functional huddle with Engineering and Quality to mitigate risks on critical programs.
* Publish schedule health KPIs from BPCS and brief leaders on variances and corrective actions.
* Coach a planner on data-governance best practices; recognize wins in a team standup.

### **Basic qualifications**

#### **Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Industrial Engineering, or a related field
* APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM)

#### **Experience**

* 8–12 years of progressive experience in manufacturing planning, supply chain, or operations management
* At least 3 years leading multi-disciplined teams

#### **Technical proficiency**

* Hands-on with mid- and upper-tier ERP systems
* Strong analytical capability, KPI dashboard development, and data-governance expertise

#### **Leadership competencies**

* Clear, influential communicator with stakeholder management strength
* Demonstrated talent development and mentorship capability

#### **Other core skills**

* Data-driven problem solving
* Change management expertise
* Continuous-improvement mindset

#### **Desired skills**

* Strategic execution—able to think long-term while delivering hands-on results
* Mentorship & team building—coaching, developing high-performing teams, and succession planning
* Business acumen—translate data into actionable insights that drive cost savings and operational excellence
* Collaboration—excel in matrix environments; foster cross-functional partnerships and knowledge sharing
* Innovation mindset—champion new tools, processes, and best practices that elevate PP&C performance

### **Tools you’ll use**

* ERP & MRP Systems
* ERP Software (including BPCS for scheduling data integrity and reporting)

new_roles.title: Senior Manager - Training & Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

**About the Team:**

**The Dow Jones Customer Service (DJCS) mission is to provide great service for our customers and great experiences for our people.**

Our team has the privilege of delivering impactful experiences by helping our customers access the trusted news and business information published and produced by our marquee brands including, The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch, Dow Jones Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance. You will find that we are a collaborative group, focused on delivering excellence during every customer interaction. We encourage anyone that wants to join us in our mission to apply.

**About the Role:**

The Senior Manager, Training & Quality Assurance is responsible for new hire training, ongoing learning, knowledge management, and quality assurance across DJCS globally. You will report to the Vice President of Customer Support Operations and be based in our New Jersey office.

**You Will**

* Own and modernize curricula across DJCS, defining content, sequence, timing, delivery methods, and readiness standards to shorten time to proficiency and support development beyond initial onboarding. Coordinate Training-led modules and specialist instruction from hiring teams within the agreed plan.
* Lead the expansion of web-based, self-paced learning for onboarding and ongoing uptraining, combining it with live instruction, systems practice, and shadowing where appropriate.
* Improve knowledge accuracy, usability, adoption, and maintenance, and prepare the team, content, and working practices for AI-enabled tools.
* Lead the adoption and validation of automated quality management (AQM) across teams and contact types, establish standards for coaching and performance scoring, and redeploy human QA toward targeted investigation and improvement.
* Develop staff capabilities and close Consumer/B2B knowledge gaps through cross-training and shared responsibilities, identifying where tools or specialist support are needed.
* Manage training capacity and delivery, oversee curriculum standards and trainer quality across outsourcing partners, and extend product training and onboarding capability beyond DJCS.
* Partner with stakeholders to understand needs, agree priorities and delivery commitments, and communicate progress and tradeoffs. Measure both program results and stakeholder feedback to ensure the team delivers effective support and a reliable partnership.

**Who you Are**

* You set a clear direction, challenge established approaches, and turn ideas into practical improvements.
* You are resourceful and persistent, working through obstacles and balancing change with daily operational demands.
* You develop people and deliver through others, setting clear expectations, building skills, and getting into the details when needed.
* You build stakeholder trust through responsiveness, honest communication, and follow-through.
* You use data, employee and stakeholder feedback, and testing to set priorities, make decisions, and measure results.

**You Have**

* 7+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience managing a training or related performance improvement team in a contact center environment, including developing staff capabilities.
* Demonstrated success leading changes to onboarding or ongoing learning, with measurable improvements in proficiency, productivity, and learning effectiveness.
* Experience leading blended learning development and delivery, including self-paced digital content, through internal teams or external specialists.
* Experience using quality evaluation or interaction analytics to identify performance gaps and measure the results of improvement initiatives.
* Experience delivering cross-functional initiatives against agreed commitments, supported by examples of effective stakeholder partnerships.
* Ability to travel up to 20%, both domestically and internationally.
* Experience implementing or expanding AQM (preferred).
* Experience managing knowledge resources or implementing AI-enabled learning, knowledge, or employee-support tools (preferred).
* Experience selecting or managing learning technology, external specialists, or outsourced training and QA programs (preferred).

**Our Benefits**

* Comprehensive Healthcare Plans
* Paid Time Off
* Retirement Plans
* Comprehensive Insurance Plans
* Education Benefits
* Family Care Benefits
* Commuter Transit Program
* Subscription Discounts
* Employee Referral Program

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. EEO/Disabled/Vets

new_roles.description:
**Position Summary...**
-----------------------

We’re looking for a Senior Manager of Ops Excellence and Resiliency to build and lead the process improvement, operational resilience, and AI transformation capabilities for Last Mile Delivery (LMD) Risk Operations. This role will turn findings and opportunities identified through Monitoring & Assurance, Risk Intelligence, incidents, and operational performance into redesigned workflows, stronger operating models, and scalable transformation roadmaps. The Senior Manager will bring a TPM/process driven mindset to simplify and standardize how work gets done, identify critical dependencies and failure points, strengthen contingency and readiness practices, and develop an AI transformation roadmap that rethinks how Risk Operations can operate—not simply make today’s manual steps faster. The role will partner across Risk Operations and with Product, Technology, Analytics, and other stakeholders to move validated opportunities from insight to sustainable operational change.

**What you'll do...**
---------------------

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build the Ops Excellence and Resiliency capability for Risk Operations, creating an integrated approach to process improvement, operational resilience, and technology-enabled transformation.
* Translate findings from Monitoring & Assurance, Risk Intelligence, root cause analysis, incidents, and operational performance into a prioritized portfolio of process, resilience, automation, and AI transformation opportunities.
* Lead end-to-end process redesign by applying a TPM/process driven mindset to simplify, standardize, and optimize Risk Operations workflows, reducing unnecessary manual work, inefficient handoffs, failure points, and unclear ownership.
* Build an operational resilience model by identifying critical processes, dependencies, single points of failure, technology and data vulnerabilities, and contingency needs across Risk Operations.
* Develop dependency maps, contingency playbooks, and operational readiness practices in partnership with process owners to help critical incident and safety response capabilities continue through disruption.
* Develop and maintain the AI transformation roadmap for Risk Operations, identifying where AI can reshape intake, investigations, monitoring, analysis, decision support, reporting, and other workflows rather than simply automate individual manual steps.
* Evaluate and prioritize AI and automation opportunities based on operational value, feasibility, risk, scalability, and alignment to business needs, and translate validated opportunities into pilots and delivery roadmaps with Product and Technology partners.
* Partner with Incident Management, Safety, Monitoring & Assurance, Risk Intelligence, Product, Technology, Analytics, Legal, Compliance, and other stakeholders to redesign workflows and implement sustainable improvements across organizational boundaries.
* Establish measures of success for transformation and resilience efforts, including cycle-time reduction, handoffs eliminated, process consistency, adoption, resilience readiness, recovery performance, and realized benefits from automation and AI-enabled changes.
* Create clear executive reporting and recommendations that show the improvement portfolio, resilience risks and readiness, AI transformation opportunities, implementation progress, dependencies, decisions required, and measurable outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in operational excellence, process engineering, continuous improvement, operational resilience, business continuity, technology transformation, program management, risk operations, or related fields.
* 3+ years leading teams or complex cross-functional initiatives in high-volume or operationally complex environments.
* Demonstrated experience redesigning and simplifying end-to-end operational processes, with the ability to translate findings and pain points into scalable future-state workflows.
* Strong process engineering and structured problem-solving capabilities, with experience identifying root causes, dependencies, failure points, and opportunities to reduce manual work and inefficient handoffs.
* Experience building or supporting operational resilience, business continuity, contingency planning, dependency mapping, or operational readiness programs.
* Experience developing and executing transformation roadmaps involving technology, automation, analytics, or AI-enabled operations, including the ability to distinguish incremental automation from broader operating-model transformation.
* Strong data-driven decision-making skills with the ability to synthesize monitoring findings, risk intelligence, operational metrics, and stakeholder input into prioritized improvement opportunities and measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication, program leadership, and influencing skills, with the ability to partner across Product, Technology, Analytics, Risk Operations, and other cross-functional teams to move ideas from identification through implementation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in last-mile delivery, gig economy platforms, marketplaces, trust & safety, transportation, retail, e-commerce, investigations, fraud/risk operations, or other high-volume decision environments.
* Familiarity with TPM, Lean/Six Sigma, process engineering, systems thinking, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience designing business continuity or operational resilience frameworks, including dependency mapping, contingency playbooks, readiness exercises, or recovery planning.
* Experience identifying, evaluating, and implementing AI and automation opportunities within complex operational workflows, including development of opportunity roadmaps, pilots, or business cases.
* Experience partnering with monitoring, assurance, risk intelligence, product, engineering, and analytics teams to convert operational findings and emerging risks into sustainable process and technology improvements.

new_roles.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

**Senior Manager Quality Compliance**

**Working at Abbott** 
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists

**The Opportunity** 
This position works out of our Plymouth, MN location in the **Electrophysiology** division, we’re advancing the treatment of heart and vascular disease through breakthrough medical technologies, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

As the **Senior Manager Quality Compliance**, you’ll provide leadership for quality system compliance initiatives, audit readiness, regulatory change management, field actions, and quality compliance strategy across the EP business. This role leads teams and collaborates across functions to strengthen compliance capabilities, support inspections and audits, and drive continuous improvement

**What You’ll Work On**

* Lead quality compliance programs, including external audit support, inspection readiness activities, and quality system effectiveness initiatives.
* Develop and execute compliance strategies for the EP business, strengthening audit capability across sites and functions.
* Manage and support Health Hazard Evaluation (HHE), RRE/SRE, field action, and remediation activities to ensure timely and compliant execution.
* Assess industry trends, regulatory changes, and standards updates, implementing solutions that advance organizational compliance.
* Lead and mentor team members while partnering with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve compliance objectives.

Quality Management Systems/Compliance

* Support life cycle of external audits (ie. execution, preparation, completion, etc).
* Drive site audit readiness for FDA & NB
* Expand compliance capabilities to support IA
* Support Certificate Management and Finance Portfolio Management
* Manage HHE and Field Action Program
* Impact Analysis on Industry Trends
* Manage Field Action Strategy, as appropriate
* As needed, support regulation and standards change assessment

People Management & Strategy

* Lead diverse team to achieve compliance goals
* Develop compliance strategy for EP BU
* Develop audit capability across EP sites and functions
* Demonstrate Compliance Expertise through Leadership Behaviors

Lead Strategic Quality & Compliance Programs

* Develop and execute global quality and compliance strategies that align with divisional priorities and long-term business objectives.
* Build and manage program roadmaps, business cases, budgets, funding requests, and implementation plans for complex, multi-workstream initiatives.
* Establish meaningful partnerships across Quality, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Commercial organizations to drive successful program execution.
* Present program strategies, progress updates, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership and key stakeholders.

Strengthen Audit Readiness & Inspection Success

* Lead and support the lifecycle of external audits, including preparation, execution, response management, and follow-up activities.
* Drive ongoing inspection readiness across global sites, including preparedness for FDA, Notified Body, and other regulatory inspections.
* Partner with site and functional leaders to identify compliance gaps, implement remediation plans, and sustain inspection readiness programs.

Advance the Global Quality Management System

* Ensure effective implementation and governance of quality programs within the division's Quality Management System.
* Assess and manage impacts of evolving global regulations, standards, and industry expectations.
* Own and coordinate standards and regulation change management activities, including impact assessments and implementation plans.
* Support certificate management activities and external certification requirements.

Lead Compliance Improvement & Risk Reduction Efforts

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance compliance effectiveness, operational efficiency, and quality performance.
* Identify opportunities to leverage technology, automation, analytics, AI-enabled solutions, training programs, and process improvements.
* Monitor quality metrics, program effectiveness, and compliance trends to proactively mitigate risk.
* Manage and communicate program dashboards and executive-level reporting.

Support Critical Quality Events & Field Actions

* Provide leadership and support for field action strategies and implementation activities when required.
* Support Health Hazard Evaluation (HHE), Risk Review Evaluation (RRE), and Software Risk Evaluation (SRE) programs to ensure timely completion and compliance.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to effectively manage quality records, communications, and closure activities.

Develop a Culture of Quality

* Mentor and advise colleagues across the organization on compliant decision-making and quality best practices.
* Enhance organizational compliance capabilities through training, consultation, and knowledge sharing.
* Monitor industry trends and emerging compliance risks to help shape future quality strategies and organizational readiness.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Industrial Technology, or a related field.
* 13+ years of combined experience in Quality, Compliance, Manufacturing Operations, Regulatory Affairs, or related functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading large, cross-functional programs in a regulated industry.
* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems and compliance processes.
* Previous management experience.
* Experience influencing stakeholders and driving results in a matrixed global organization.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and executive-facing leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Medical device, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated industry experience.
* Experience supporting FDA inspections, Notified Body audits, MDSAP, ISO standards, or related regulatory environments.
* International experience and/or foreign language proficiency.
* Experience with audit readiness programs, field actions, regulatory change management, and quality system governance.
* Strong analytical and business acumen with the ability to connect compliance requirements to operational and business outcomes

.

### **Apply Now**

**Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:** https://abbottbenefits.com/

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

Connect with us at abbott.com, on LinkedIn at https://www.linkedin.com/company/abbott-/, and on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/AbbottCareers.

new_roles.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

As the Senior Manager, Performance and Quality, you'll lead proposal development and formal client responses for the account, and coordinate the team's responses to client, external, and government audits. You'll turn complex contract, pricing, performance guarantee, and operational requirements into accurate, persuasive, on-time submissions. Every commitment and audit response you produce is supported, traceable, and clear to the client. In Finance and Contract Compliance, you'll link what proposals promise to how performance and quality are checked through audits and corrective action. You will also project-manage implementations and changes on the account.

**Primary responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Develop proposal strategies and response plans for renewals, RFPs, RFIs, client-requested program and benefit-change proposals, and contract amendments that align with account objectives and client requirements.
* Manage the end-to-end development and submission of proposals and formal client responses, from requirement intake through final review and delivery.
* Partner with account, executive, Finance, Legal, Clinical, and Operations leadership to define key messages and value propositions, and confirm that pricing, performance guarantee, and contract commitments are accurate and approved before submission.
* Write clear, persuasive, client-ready narratives and executive communications about capabilities, program results, and positions, and represent the team in client meetings on proposals and deliverables.
* Lead project management for implementations and account changes, such as new programs, vendor transitions, and benefit or system changes. Build and manage project plans for these and for RFPs, renewals, contract amendments, client deliverables, and audit responses, with timelines, milestones, owners, and dependencies. Plan for compressed client turnaround times and escalate at-risk items early.
* Research client needs, program developments, and market and competitive trends to inform proposal strategy and client recommendations.
* Implement standardized templates, content libraries, style guides, and quality checklists for proposals and audit responses, and train contributors to use them.
* Support contract negotiations during RFPs and amendments by coordinating redlines and negotiating items with Legal and leadership, and documenting each decision to keep, trade, or drop an item, with its approver, so the rationale stays on record.
* Own the audit request log and coordinate intake, scoping, ownership, and evidence production for client, external, and government audits of the account, including third-party audits triggered by performance guarantee escalation provisions.
* Perform quality reviews of audit responses and evidence packages to confirm every part of the request is addressed, amounts reconcile, and the response is clear to an independent reviewer; coordinate secure submission and retain final versions.
* Maintain internal corrective action plans (CAPs) for known contract breaches, so completed fixes are documented before the client asks, and lead the response when the client invokes the contract's formal CAP process. Track audit findings, management responses, fixes, and closeout against contract timelines, and report recurring performance and quality themes to leadership.

**Key deliverables**
--------------------

* Proposal and client-response calendar, plus a project plan for each RFP, renewal, contract amendment, implementation, and major account change.
* Proposal strategies and response plans for renewals, RFPs, RFIs, and client-requested proposals.
* Standard content library, templates, style guide, and quality checklist.
* Commitment and negotiating-items log tying each commitment and redline decision to its approver and source.
* Audit request log, scope and ownership matrix, and evidence-package standards.
* Internal CAP register for known contract breaches, plus a findings, management-response, and corrective-action tracker and audit closeout packages.
* Leadership summaries of open proposals, implementation and change status, at-risk deliverables, and audit status.

***\*\*\*This is a remote role, but the ideal candidate will live in the Eastern Time Zone\*\*\****

**Minimum qualifications**

* 7+ years of work experience.
* Experience managing end-to-end proposal or RFP responses for complex healthcare or PBM clients.
* Experience planning, executing, and delivering across concurrent deadlines and owners.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and proposal content-management tools.

**Preferred qualifications**

* PBM, health plan, or government program experience, including implementations or vendor transitions.
* Experience coordinating audits, regulatory requests, or evidence-based client reviews.
* Experience validating pricing, performance guarantee, or contract commitments in proposals.
* Proposal management or project management certification.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$67,900.00 - $182,549.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program.

new_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

**Summary of Position****:**

The Senior Quality Manager of Flight Line Quality Control Management, and Execution of Helicopter Flight Line of an FAA part 21 approved Quality System. The Senior Manager, Quality Control of Flight Line will ensure compliance and safety, balanced with cost in alignment with operations to safely bring aircraft to pre-flight, ground test, and flight testing. Driving the finalization process to the delivery and acceptance intent on ZERO defect aircraft being presented to customers. Provide technical leadership, leaning on knowledge of FAA P21 requirements, AS9100, and aerospace knowledge. The Senior Quality Manager of Flight Line, will also focus on personnel management and development, ensuring competencies equal to the business and market requirements. The Senior Manager will have a Continuous Improvement approach to processes while executing to the business plan.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities****:**

* Safe and on time actions bringing Production Helicopters to Operation, Ground Run, Flights, Acceptance & Delivery to Customer
* Resource Management, deployment of resources, training and building out Competencies of resources to meet customer and market demand
* Ensure compliance of Quality System with all relevant, FAA guidelines, procedures and policies.
* Represents QC as the prime contact for customer delivery activities
* Proactive measures in the planning and execution of aircraft operations, customer Acceptance and Delivery activity
* Continuous Improvement: using methods like DMAIC, statistical analysis to understand and improve processes and contributing to the efficiency of the Flight Line Operation

**Qualifications for Position****:**

**A. Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aviation Management, or a related technical discipline

**B. Experience**

* 5+ years of management and Quality experience or Equivalent

**C. Competencies & Attributes**

The successful candidate will have a working knowledge of AS9100 QMS and FAA requirements. Experience in Lean/Six Sigma, and a demonstrated approach to the job is a must. Must be a Leader and Change Agent with sound fundamentals in Quality Principles in Aerospace and Continuous Improvement. This Leader must demonstrate the ability to engage with partners and shareholders to find solutions, in execution and process. The candidate mut also demonstrate the ability to engage with stakeholders at Executive levels, internally, and externally including customers from the commercial and defense sectors.

**D. Licensure/Certification**

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt desired, Green belt required
* ASQ Certification highly desired
* FAA Airframe and Powerplant (A&P) License or verified military equivalent desired

**Primary Location:**

US - Philadelphia

**Contract Type:**

new_roles.title: SR. DIRECTOR, QUALITY ASSURANCE
new_roles.description:
At El Pollo Loco, we are on a mission to be the nation’s leading fire-grilled chicken restaurant. When it comes to our people, we are all about growth. Whether that means specialized training, a clearly laid out career trajectory or collaborating cross-functionally, we are committed to the success of our people the same way we’ve been committed to the success of the El Pollo Loco brand for the last 50 years. In fact, we see you as our secret ingredient. While our chicken is fire, it’s our people who set us ablaze.
 
 
Our restaurants are only the tip of the flame! If you’re looking for an innovative, winning, and welcoming workplace, then a flamin’ good career in our Restaurant Support Center is right for you.
 
 
At our Support Center, we believe our best work is done Together, when departments collaborate and everyone is confident in contributing their ideas. This is why we are in the office 3 days per week.
 
 
Let’s Get Loco!
 
 
What’s in it for you!
 
 

* STRONG office culture recognized as a Great Place to Work® and driven by our core values: Simple. Together. Relentless. Ownership. Nimble. Growth
* Career growth opportunities
* Competitive pay and bonus potential
* Be an Owner: Equity Compensation
* Medical + Dental + Vision Insurance + HSA Savings Account
* 401(K) Retirement Plan with company match and immediate vesting
* Paid Vacation + Sick Pay + 12 Paid Holidays
* Employee Assistance Program
* Free El Pollo Loco food + restaurant discounts
* PerkSpot discounts program

**POSITION PURPOSE:** 
The Senior Director, Quality Assurance owns El Pollo Loco's enterprise quality assurance function end to end, consolidating vendor-level quality assurance and regulatory food safety compliance into a single point of accountability. This role is responsible for the integrity of the supply chain's quality systems — from supplier and co-manufacturer qualification through regulatory compliance across federal, state, and local agencies — and serves as the primary quality and food safety resource to the franchise system.
 
 
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 
Vendor & Supplier Quality Assurance
 

* Directs vendor and supplier quality assurance programs across El Pollo Loco's poultry portfolio, including fresh leg quarters (“Saddles”) and value-added further-processed chicken items, ensuring specification integrity, ingredient consistency, and product quality at every stage of the supply chain.
* Leads vendor qualification, audit, scorecarding, and corrective-action programs; partners with Procurement and Distribution to resolve quality holds, non-conformances, and supplier performance issues.
* Owns quality specifications for co-manufactured and further-processed chicken products, working directly with processors to validate manufacturing controls, shelf-life, and food safety design prior to system-wide rollout.
* Evaluates and approves new vendors, ingredients, and product formulations, ensuring alignment with brand quality standards and regulatory requirements.

Regulatory & Food Safety Compliance
 

* Serves as the company's senior point of accountability for food safety regulatory compliance, including FDA, USDA, FSMA, HACCP, GFSI, and state and local health department requirements across all operating jurisdictions.
* Builds and maintains direct working relationships with state and federal regulatory agencies; leads the company's response to regulatory inquiries, inspections, and enforcement actions.
* Owns crisis management, product withdrawal, and recall protocols (including activation of the Level 3 Withdrawal Process), partnering with executive leadership and legal counsel as needed.
* Directs internal and third-party food safety audit programs spanning restaurants, distribution centers, and manufacturing partners.

Team Leadership & Franchise Support
 

* Builds, leads, and develops a high-performing QA organization spanning both vendor quality and regulatory food safety disciplines; sets performance expectations, coaching plans, and succession pipelines for direct reports.
* Serves as a critical QA partner to the franchise system, delivering training, technical guidance, and responsive support to franchisees on quality and food safety matters.
* Represents Quality Assurance in cross-functional and executive leadership forums, translating vendor and regulatory risk into clear, actionable guidance for Operations and senior leadership.
* Other duties as assigned by the SVP, Supply Chain & Quality Assurance.

QUALIFICATIONS – EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, LICENSE/CERTIFICATIONS:
 
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. The requirements listed below are representative of the education and/or experience required.
 
 
**Education/Work Experience:** 
BA/BS in Food Science, Food Microbiology, or a related field required; Master's degree preferred. Minimum 12+ years of progressive quality assurance and food safety experience, with substantial, direct experience in poultry and value-added/further-processed chicken products required. Demonstrated background working directly with state and federal regulatory agencies (FDA, USDA, state health departments) on compliance, inspections, or enforcement matters required. Prior experience directly managing and developing a quality assurance team required.
 
 
**License/Certifications:** 
Valid driver's license required. HACCP certification required; PCQI (Preventive Controls Qualified Individual) preferred.
 
 
**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** 

* Proven track record building, managing, and developing high-performing quality assurance teams, with strong people-leadership, coaching, and succession-planning skills.
* Deep working knowledge of value-added and further-processed chicken manufacturing, including co-manufacturer oversight, specification management, and shelf-life validation.
* Established credibility with state and federal regulatory agencies; skilled at navigating inspections, audits, and enforcement proceedings with composure and precision.
* Demonstrated ability to support and train franchisees on quality and food safety standards, balancing brand protection with practical, field-level guidance.
* Confidence in execution of strategic initiatives; decisive and able to make fact-based decisions under pressure.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset and skills; meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to effectively communicate with internal and external business partners, including vendors, regulators, and franchisees.
* Ability to prioritize and plan competing, time-sensitive work assignments under frequent, tight deadlines.
* Ability to read, write, and interpret complex regulatory reports, contracts, and correspondence.
* Ability to exercise independent judgment on matters of significant risk and consequence to the company.
* Ability to work weekends and extended work schedules as needed.
* Willing and able to travel locally within Southern California and to out-of-state vendor, distribution, and restaurant locations, as needed, by car or airplane.

Our Company
 
 
In 1980 the first American El Pollo Loco opened on Alvarado Street in Los Angeles, quickly becoming a destination for the best citrus-marinated, fire-grilled pollo in town. Over the past four decades, El Pollo Loco has grown into more than 500 restaurants across 9 states, becoming an L.A. mainstay and cultural benchmark along the way. Today, we continue to work just as hard to always provide our customers with Quality Chicken. Fast. Easy. Affordable.
 
 
PAY DISCLAIMER – CA ONLY
 
The pay range identified is the hourly or salary rate El Pollo Loco expects to pay for the posted position. This range does not include any benefits or bonus opportunities that might be available for the position based on position and eligibility criteria. At El Pollo Loco, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the high end of the range. Individual pay decisions will vary based on a variety of factors including years of experience, industry experience, education, geography, etc.

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance
new_roles.description:
Sun Life U.S. is one of the largest providers of employee and government benefits, helping approximately 50 million Americans access the care and coverage they need. Through employers, industry partners and government programs, Sun Life U.S. offers a portfolio of benefits and services, including dental, vision, disability, absence management, life, supplemental health, medical stop-loss insurance, and healthcare navigation. We have more than 6,400 employees and associates in our partner dental practices and operate nationwide.

 

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

 

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

 

Visit our website to discover how Sun Life is making life brighter for our customers, partners and communities.

*DentaQuest manages dental and vision benefits for more than 33 million Americans. Our outcomes-based, cost-effective solutions are designed for Medicaid and CHIP, Medicare Advantage, small and large businesses, and individuals. With a focus on prevention and value, we aim to make quality care accessible to improve the oral health of all.*

**Job Description:**

**Location:** Sun Life embraces a hybrid work model that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility of virtual work. Our team members and leaders are expected to foster connection and teamwork by being present in the office at least 2 days per week.

 

**The opportunity:**

The Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance leads the Quality Assurance function within Dental Shared Services and is accountable for the consistent execution of quality monitoring, audit, calibration, reporting, and improvement activities across supported operations. This role manages quality teams and programs, translates performance data into actionable recommendations, and partners with Operations, Compliance, Training, Workforce Management, Client Engagement, Technology, and Business Process Outsourcing partners to strengthen controls, address risk, and improve member, provider, client, and business outcomes.

 
 

**How you will contribute:**

* Manage the day-to-day execution and continuous improvement of quality assurance programs across Dental Shared Services and supported operational functions, including Contact Center, Claims, Utilization Management, Provider Operations, Complaints and Grievances, Member Enrollment, Intake and Digital Services, and Vision operations.

* Establish and maintain audit procedures, sampling approaches, quality standards, calibration routines, and reporting practices aligned with contractual, regulatory, client, and internal control requirements.

* Lead, coach, and develop quality leaders and professionals by setting clear expectations, balancing workloads, monitoring productivity and accuracy, and supporting engagement, accountability, and career development.

* Analyze quality results, disputes, appeals, re-audits, and operational trends to identify root causes, emerging risks, and practical opportunities for improvement.

* Partner with Operations, Training, Workforce Management, Compliance, Client Engagement, Technology, and BPO leadership to develop and monitor corrective actions, coaching plans, training updates, and sustainable performance improvements.

* Manage client audit and calibration activities, including call and case selection, audit review, documentation preparation, meeting participation, follow-up, and timely response to client or regulatory inquiries.

* Coordinate quality support for internal, external, regulatory, and client audits; prepare evidence, contribute to management action plans, validate remediation, and track findings through closure.

* Implement quality improvement and technology initiatives, including automation, speech analytics, AWS Contact Lens, end-to-end review models, enhanced reporting, and expanded quality monitoring capabilities.

* Assess staffing, capacity, audit volumes, and competing priorities; recommend resource adjustments that support required coverage, service commitments, and cost-effective delivery.

* Maintain enhanced oversight for high-risk, high-profile, and penalty-impacting clients through targeted audit criteria, clear escalation paths, and proactive communication routines.

* Represent Quality Assurance in cross-functional forums, operational readiness activities, transformation projects, vendor discussions, compliance meetings, and leadership reviews.

* Prepare and present quality results, risks, recommendations, and improvement plans to business leaders, clients, and cross-functional partners.

* Promote a culture of accountability, compliance, continuous improvement, collaboration, and client-focused service delivery.

* Perform other duties as assigned.

 
 

**What you will bring with you:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Operations Management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

* Seven or more years of progressive experience in quality assurance, healthcare operations, dental operations, contact center operations, claims, compliance, or related business operations.

* Three or more years of leadership or people management experience, preferably in a quality assurance, operations, or shared services environment.

* Experience supporting government, commercial, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, or other regulated healthcare programs preferred.

* Strong knowledge of quality monitoring, audit methodology, calibration, root cause analysis, corrective action planning, internal controls, and performance improvement practices.

* Experience working with BPO partners, client audits, regulatory audits, and cross-functional operational teams preferred.

* Experience with reporting, dashboards, quality analytics, speech analytics, call recording tools, contact center platforms, or AWS Contact Lens preferred.

* Sound business judgment with the ability to connect quality performance to client, compliance, operational, and financial outcomes.

* Strong people leadership, coaching, performance management, and talent development skills.

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, determine root causes, and recommend practical solutions.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings, risks, and recommendations to leaders, clients, and cross-functional audiences.

* Strong project management, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, and competing priorities.

* Ability to influence without direct authority and build effective partnerships across Operations, Compliance, Training, Technology, Client Engagement, and vendor teams.

* Demonstrated ability to lead teams through change, implement standardized processes, and support technology-enabled transformation.

* High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, compliance, confidentiality, and ethical business practices.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, SharePoint, and Teams.

 

**Salary:** $76,000 - 115,000

At our company, we are committed to pay transparency and equity. The salary range for this role is competitive nationwide, and we strive to ensure that compensation is fair and equitable. Your actual base salary will be determined based on your unique skills, qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. In addition to your base salary, this position is eligible for a discretionary annual incentive award based on your individual performance as well as the overall performance of the business. We are dedicated to creating a work environment where everyone is rewarded for their contributions.

Not ready to apply yet but want to stay in touch? Join our talent community to stay connected until the time is right for you!

We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all employees feel they belong, are supported and empowered to thrive. We are dedicated to building teams with varied experiences, backgrounds, perspectives and ideas that benefit our colleagues, clients, and the communities where we operate. We encourage applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

**Life is brighter when you work at Sun Life**

At Sun Life, we prioritize your well-being with comprehensive benefits, including generous vacation and sick time, market-leading paid family, parental and adoption leave, medical coverage, company paid life and AD&D insurance, disability programs and a partially paid sabbatical program. Plan for your future with our 401(k) employer match, stock purchase options and an employer-funded retirement account. Enjoy a flexible, inclusive and collaborative work environment that supports career growth. We’re proud to be recognized in our communities as a top employer. Proudly Great Place to Work® Certified in Canada and the U.S., we’ve also been recognized as a "Top 10" employer by the Boston Globe's "Top Places to Work" for two years in a row. Visit our website to learn more about our benefits and recognition within our communities.

We will make reasonable accommodation s to the known physical or mental limitation s of otherwise-qualified individuals with disabilities or special disabled veterans , unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business. Please email thebrightside@sunlife.com to request an accommodation.

For applicants residing in California, please read our employee California Privacy Policy and Notice.

We do not require or administer lie detector tests as a condition of employment or continued employment.

Sun Life will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including applicable fair chance ordinances.

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected vetera* n.

Business Analysis - Process

new_roles.title: Senior Manager - Technology Operations Engineering
new_roles.description:
Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues.

We are seeking an experienced and technically strong **Senior Manager – Technology Operations Engineering** to lead Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Application Production Support, and operational excellence for enterprise Contact Center Transformation platforms.

This role will be responsible for ensuring the **end-to-end availability, reliability, performance, scalability, and operational stability** of mission-critical voice platforms, contact center applications, cloud-native services, intelligent voice bots, and AI-powered customer engagement solutions.

The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP), SRE practices, enterprise application support, Five9, Genesys, telephony technologies, full-stack observability, distributed tracing, and incident management** . The role also requires knowledge of emerging technologies, including Agentic AI frameworks, AI agent monitoring, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

The Senior Manager will lead engineering teams responsible for 24x7 production support, proactive monitoring, incident resolution, problem management, change management, automation, and continuous reliability improvements across complex, distributed contact center ecosystems.

 

* **Education & Professional Experience:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, with **10+ years of experience** in Technology Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, Application Production Support, or Cloud Engineering, including **5+ years in technical leadership or engineering management roles** .

* **Site Reliability Engineering & Application Support:** Extensive hands-on experience in **SRE, enterprise application production support, distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs, application performance troubleshooting, service reliability, and 24x7 production operations** , including on-call support and critical incident resolution.

new_roles.title: Sourcing Director: NPI Execution, M&A Integration & Supplier Transfers
new_roles.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------

The Director, NPI Execution, M&A Integration & Supplier Transfers leads strategic execution across new product introduction, acquired-business integration, and supplier/manufacturing transfer initiatives. This senior leader is accountable for ensuring products, processes, supply chains, and teams transition successfully from development, acquisition, or incumbent suppliers into stable, compliant, scalable operations. 
The role requires strong business judgment, deep supply-base knowledge, technical fluency, and the ability to lead complex programs in a regulated medical-device environment. The Director partners closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, R&D, Finance, Manufacturing Engineering, and leadership to deliver continuity of supply, cost competitiveness, product quality, and growth objectives. 
 
Reports to: Senior Director Procurement (Cost Center - M&A) 
Direct reports: Integration Program leaders, supplier-transfer leaders, NPI project managers, supplier development personnel

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------

1. NPI Execution and Operational Readiness 

* Lead the end-to-end operational execution of New Product Introduction programs, from design-transfer planning through commercialization and sustained production.
* Establish integrated NPI execution plans & Ensure alignment between product development timelines and operational deliverables, including design transfer, process characterization, validation, supplier readiness, and product availability.
* Drive structured phase-gate governance with external suppliers , program reviews, escalation mechanisms, and executive decision-making for high-priority launches.

 
2. M&A Operations Integration 

* Serve as the Procurement lead for M&A integrations.
* Executes the integration for acquired companies for mitigation of supply-chain risk, supplier dependencies, tier-II management, partners with SQ team for quality-system maturity.
* Define and lead integration roadmaps for acquired businesses, including supplier onboarding, quality-system alignment, tier-II management and smooth transition to Contract manufacturing partner(s)
* Lead Procurement part of integration governance, ensuring milestones, decisions, risks, and accountabilities are visible and managed at the appropriate leadership level.

 
3. Supplier Transfer and Supply-Base Optimization 

* Lead complex supplier-transfer programs, including strategic sourcing transitions, supplier exits, dual-source strategies, vertical-integration initiatives, and manufacturing footprint changes.
* Develop transfer strategies that balance continuity of supply, quality, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements, cost, capacity, and timing.
* Ensure supplier transfers are executed in accordance with applicable quality-system requirements, change-control processes, validation requirements, and regulatory commitments.
* Direct supplier selection, qualification, technical transfer, process validation, first-article activities, production ramp-up, and supplier performance monitoring.

 
4. People Leadership and Organizational Capability 

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of program, technical, supply-chain, and supplier-management professionals.
* Set clear goals, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for direct reports.
* Build succession capability and strengthen organizational depth in NPI execution, technical operations, supplier transfer, and integration management.
* Foster cross-functional collaboration among teams with potentially competing objectives, timelines, and priorities.

**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------

Leadership 

* Builds high-performing teams and develops future leaders.
* Establishes clarity, accountability, and disciplined execution
* Leads through ambiguity, organizational change, and competing business priorities.

Business Acumen 

* Connects technical and operational decisions to financial, customer, and enterprise outcomes.
* Evaluates strategic tradeoffs with an enterprise-wide perspective.
* Identifies opportunities for value creation, risk reduction, and sustainable growth.

Technical and Procurement Expertise 

* Understands manufacturing processes, product industrialization, supplier capabilities, process controls, validation, and quality-system expectations.
* Demonstrates strong command of supply-base dynamics, supplier economics, sourcing strategy, and operational risk.
* Can challenge technical assumptions constructively and facilitate fact-based decisions.

Program Execution 

* Drives complex initiatives from strategy through implementation and stabilization.
* Uses effective governance, metrics, risk management, and escalation practices.
* Maintains focus on customer service, quality, compliance, delivery, and financial results.

Influence and Collaboration 

* Builds credibility with senior leaders, technical experts, plant leadership, suppliers, and all other stakeholders.
* Resolves conflict constructively and aligns diverse stakeholders behind common objectives.
* Communicates complex issues in a concise, actionable manner.

**Your Background**
-------------------

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business, or a related technical discipline.
* Approximately 20 years of progressive experience in medical devices, life sciences, advanced manufacturing, or another highly regulated industry.
* Hands on experience & leadership experience in one or more of the following areas:
* New Product Introduction and product industrialization
* Strategic Sourcing and Supplier Management
* Supplier Transfers or Manufacturing Transfers
* Mergers, Acquisitions, and Business Integration
* Supply Chain, Procurement, or Operations Program Management
* Proven people-management experience, including leading managers and technical professionals in a matrixed global environment.
* Strong knowledge of supplier qualification, supplier development, capacity planning, quality agreements, process validation, and manufacturing transfer principles.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate and manage supply-base risk, including sole-source exposure, capacity constraints, supplier quality issues, and business-continuity risks.
* Strong financial acumen, including business-case development, cost analysis, budget ownership, and value-capture management.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and influencing skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting medical-device product launches and design-transfer activities.
* Experience integrating acquired companies, product portfolios, manufacturing sites, or supplier networks.
* Familiarity with regulated quality systems and supplier-control expectations.
* Experience with lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, operational excellence, or structured problem-solving methodologies.
* Experience leading global suppliers and geographically distributed teams.
* Professional certifications in program management, supply chain, quality, or lean methodologies are desirable.

**Expected Compensation Data**
------------------------------

$166,500.00 - $208,300.00
